title: butea listeri
intro: Butea listeri, commonly known as Semal or Bija, is a flowering tree native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Butea listeri include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which helps in reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress and infections. The therapeutic actions of Butea listeri include its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, as well as its potential application in wound healing and skin regeneration. The bioactive constituents of Butea listeri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
